name: Minimum Fibonacci Dimension for Isometric Avoidance Families
statement: Let $k\ge|f|$. If $|f|\ge3$ and $f$ is an isometric forbidden word, then $Q_k^{\mathrm{av}}(f)$ is a partial cube with isometric dimension $k$. If $\{11,f\}$ is isometric and $f\ne010$, then $Q_k^{\mathrm{av}}(\{11,f\})$ has both isometric and Fibonacci dimension $k$. For $f=010$ the graph is $C_4$, with dimensions two and three.
proof: Isometricity of the forbidden language makes the induced word graph isometric in $Q_k$; when $|f|\ge3$, every coordinate remains active, so the isometric dimension is $k$. Avoiding 11 places the family inside $\Gamma_k$, giving Fibonacci dimension at most $k$, while isometric dimension gives the matching lower bound. The exceptional word 010 collapses the allowed graph to a 4-cycle, whose two dimensions are known directly.
